form.label: Alert Detail
form.description: Enrich, investigate, and submit triage decisions. All changes persist to KV Store with a full audit trail.

search.query: `soc_alerts_normalized` | where alert_id="$alert_id$" | eval Priority=case(severity="critical","🔴 CRITICAL",severity="high","🟠 HIGH",severity="medium","🟡 MEDIUM",severity="low","🟢 LOW",true(),"⚪ unknown"), _sla_due=strptime(sla_due,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), SLA=if(now()>_sla_due,"⚠️ BREACHED ".round((now()-_sla_due)/60,0)." min ago","✅ ".round((_sla_due-now())/60,0)." min remaining"), Tier=case(tier_queue="t1","T1 — Intake",tier_queue="t2","T2 — Investigate",tier_queue="t3","T3 — Hunt/Tune",true(),"T1 — Intake"), Owner=if(isnull(owner) OR owner="","⚠️ UNASSIGNED",owner) | rename alert_id as "Alert ID", rule_name as "Detection Rule", entity as Entity, risk_score as "Risk Score", status as Status, created_at as Created, triage_last_updated as "Last Triaged", data_source as Source | table "Alert ID" "Detection Rule" Entity Priority "Risk Score" Status Owner Tier SLA Created "Last Triaged" Source

div.span: 📥 T1 Intake — tier=t1 • assign owner • status=in_progress
🔍 Escalate T2 — tier=t2 • add investigation notes
🚨 Escalate T3 — tier=t3 • add hunt/tune justification

panel.title: ✏️ Triage Decision — Set fields then click Submit

input.label: Assign To
input.populatingSearch: | inputlookup soc_analyst_roster | where active="true" | eval display_label=display_name." [".tier."]" | table username display_label | sort display_label

search.query: | makeresults | eval _key="$alert_id$", alert_id="$alert_id$", status="$new_status$", owner="$new_owner$", severity="$new_severity$", tier_queue="$new_tier$", notes="$new_notes$", escalated_by=if("$new_tier$"!="t1","$env:user$",null()), escalated_at=if("$new_tier$"!="t1",strftime(now(),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),null()), last_updated=strftime(now(),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | fields - _time | outputlookup append=false soc_alert_triage | eval result="✅ Saved — ".alert_id." | status=".status." | tier=".tier_queue." | owner=".owner | table result

| makeresults | eval alert_id="$alert_id$", action="triage_update", actor="$env:user$", timestamp=strftime(now(),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), after_status="$new_status$", comment="tier=$new_tier$ | owner=$new_owner$ | $new_notes$" | fields - _time | outputlookup append=true soc_triage_audit | eval result="📋 Audit logged by $env:user$" | table result

panel.title: 📋 Audit History — All actions on this alert

search.query: | inputlookup soc_triage_audit | where alert_id="$alert_id$" | sort - timestamp | table timestamp actor action after_status comment

`soc_alerts_normalized` | eval is_focal=if(alert_id="$alert_id$",1,0) | eventstats values(eval(if(is_focal=1,entity,null()))) as focal_entity | where is_focal=0 AND entity=focal_entity AND isnotnull(focal_entity) | eval Priority=case(severity="critical","🔴",severity="high","🟠",severity="medium","🟡",true(),"🟢") | sort - created_at | head 15 | table alert_id rule_name entity Priority risk_score status owner created_at
index=notable orig_sid="$alert_id$" OR rule_id="$alert_id$" | eval age_min=round((now()-_time)/60,0) | table _time rule_name user dest src urgency status search_name age_min | sort - _time

| makeresults | eval asset="$alert_id$" | lookup soc_asset_criticality entity as asset OUTPUT criticality, asset_type, asset_owner, business_unit, notes as asset_notes | eval Criticality=coalesce(criticality,"⚠️ not in KV"), Asset_Owner=coalesce(asset_owner,"unknown"), Asset_Type=coalesce(asset_type,"unknown"), Source=if(isnotnull(criticality),"💾 SOC KV soc_asset_criticality","⚠️ add asset to soc_asset_criticality KV") | table asset Criticality Asset_Type Asset_Owner business_unit asset_notes Source

panel.title: 👤 User Risk Score (ES Risk Framework → SOC KV fallback)

search.query: | makeresults | eval risk_object="$alert_id$" | append [search index=risk risk_object="$alert_id$" earliest=-7d | stats max(risk_score) as es_risk dc(source) as detections values(source) as risk_sources by risk_object | head 1] | lookup soc_user_risk user as risk_object OUTPUT risk_score as soc_risk, risk_level, risk_reasons, last_updated | eval Risk_Score=coalesce(es_risk,soc_risk,0), Risk_Level=coalesce(risk_level,case(Risk_Score>=75,"🔴 HIGH",Risk_Score>=50,"🟠 MEDIUM",true(),"🟢 LOW")), Source=case(isnotnull(es_risk),"✅ ES Risk Framework",isnotnull(soc_risk),"💾 SOC KV Lookup",true(),"⚠️ none") | where risk_object="$alert_id$" | dedup risk_object | table risk_object Risk_Score Risk_Level Source detections risk_sources risk_reasons last_updated

| makeresults | eval user="$alert_id$" | lookup soc_user_risk user OUTPUT risk_score, risk_level, risk_reasons, last_updated as risk_last_updated | lookup soc_asset_criticality entity as user OUTPUT asset_type, business_unit, asset_owner as account_owner | eval Risk_Score=coalesce(risk_score,0), Risk_Level=coalesce(risk_level,case(Risk_Score>=75,"🔴 HIGH",Risk_Score>=50,"🟠 MEDIUM",true(),"🟢 LOW")), Account_Owner=coalesce(account_owner,"unknown"), Source=case(isnotnull(risk_score),"💾 SOC KV soc_user_risk",true(),"⚠️ not in KV") | table user Risk_Score Risk_Level Account_Owner business_unit asset_type risk_reasons risk_last_updated Source

| inputlookup soc_threat_intel | search ioc="$alert_id$" | eval Match="💾 KV MATCH" | table ioc ioc_type category confidence source expiry Match | append [search index=threatlists (ip="$alert_id$" OR domain="$alert_id$" OR url="$alert_id$") earliest=-30d | stats count values(category) as categories values(source) as sources by ip domain url | eval ioc=coalesce(ip,domain,url), Match="⚡ LIVE TI HIT", ioc_type="ip/domain/url" | table ioc ioc_type categories sources Match] | dedup ioc
